meta.latest_station_wise_year: 2021-22 (annual, Aug 2022 report) - latest CEA report with a published station-wise table
also: 2022-23 H1 (Apr-Sep 2022) half-yearly report: Tamil Nadu rows only parsed
2024-25 annual report (Jan 2026, published Aug 2026): only state/sector aggregates + list of 189 plants with CEA coordinates; its per-state tables are images and no station-wise numbers are published
Fly Ash Year Book 2026 (FAYB2026-1.pdf, ref period 2025-26) on CEA site is a 1-page cover only as of 2026-09-24
meta.parse_notes: 2021-22 parsed from Annexure-II (state-wise) via pdftotext -layout; wrapped names repaired by hand for 4 rows; fly_ash_generated ~= coal_consumed*ash% checked for all rows (only Hinduja NPCL deviates, as in source). utilisation >100% means legacy pond ash also used.
